name: Himitsuri no Lagoon
source:
After losing his job, Kuugo reunites with an old friend and starts working at a small town cafe, the Lagoon Lounge.

Business has been good lately due to an increase in tourism -- people coming to experience the mysterious phenomenon known as "the Giant of Harasu."

But when other strange things begin to happen, Kuugo wonders if something sinister is behind it...
